faq.q: How is the area name spelled, and how is the school name spelled?
faq.a: The area is spelled "Neilsen Grove"; the school is spelled "Neilson Grove Elementary", at 5500 Admiral Blvd on its School District 37 school site and in the BC Ministry of Education K-12 schools file.

faq.q: Which elementary school is physically in Neilsen Grove?
faq.a: Neilson Grove Elementary, at 5500 Admiral Blvd; the SD37 School Locator result recorded in the program's base research for that sample address is Neilson Grove Elementary for K–7 and Delta Secondary for 8–12.

faq.q: Which bus runs on Admiral Boulevard?
faq.a: TransLink route 618, the Ladner North loop from Ladner Exchange, returns through the area via Admiral Way and Admiral Boulevard and Westminster Avenue.

faq.q: Are secondary suites allowed on single detached lots here?
faq.a: Yes — the RS1 zone lists a secondary suite as an accessory use, and Delta's SSMUH zoning updates allow up to four units on all single-detached and duplex lots where the zoning applies.

Ladner is low land protected by the City of Delta's flood protection system — dikes, seawalls and foreshore protection, over 63 kilometres of infrastructure, plus 31 drainage pump stations maintained by the City.
